title: Unnamed Titan 006
summary: An unnamed Titan was encountered by the team of Metz, Simon Judeau, and Eathon Lambert when they were trying to find hidden Titans for the Huntik Foundation. It was joined by Unnamed Titan 004 and Unnamed Titan 005. [The Secret of Two Generations]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
*This Titan's appearance is derived from the final form of the [[w:c:winx:Nightmare Gargoyle|Nightmare Gargoyle]] from ''[[:w:c:winx:Winx Club Wiki|Winx Club]]'', another series created by [[Iginio Straffi]]. The original form of said monster was used as the design for [[Impet]].
